verdict: Sweetened Teh O ais is slightly lower in calories, but the difference is small. What matters more is how many glasses and how sweet.
why: Teh tarik is about 120 kcal, sweetened Teh O ais around 90 kcal. Only a 30 kcal difference.
Teh tarik has 3 g protein and 4 g fat from milk. Teh O ais has almost no protein or fat.
Almost all of Teh O ais's calories come from sugar. With a big glass or 'ikat tepi' (takeaway bag), the calories go up.
Iced drinks are easy to gulp down in hot weather, so many people order a second glass.
when_a: Teh tarik is okay when you want to sip slowly while chatting. One glass is enough.
when_b: Teh O ais suits a hot, sunny day, especially if you ask for less sweet.
tip: Ask for Teh O ais limau 'kurang manis' (less sweet) or 'kosong' (no sugar). Still refreshing, with far fewer calories.

faq.a: For one glass, not much. But if you drink 2-3 glasses a day every day, it adds up. Cutting sugar makes more of a difference.

faq.q: Is Teh O ais kosong okay?
faq.a: Very okay. Almost no calories and still quenches your thirst.
